name: Destination: Prague
source:
When your travel agents go on a date, you have to take the trip into your own hands. Join Christian—a teddy bear on a tour around Europe—and his friends as they discover the European capital with the help of a local guide.

Get off the beaten path and discover interesting spots beyond the historical city centre. Glimpse into Czech daily life, culture, and history—and help all plushies get back to their home countries!

Destination: Prague is a short visual novel initially developed for NaNoRenO 2020.

[From [url=https://azardragneel.itch.io/destination-prague]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
旅行代理人约会去了，你只好自己张罗这趟旅程。和正在欧洲旅行的泰迪熊克里斯蒂安及其朋友们一起，在当地向导的带领下探索这座欧洲首都。

离开常规观光路线，发掘历史城区之外的有趣去处。了解捷克的日常生活、文化与历史，并帮助所有毛绒玩偶回到各自的祖国！

《Destination: Prague》是一部最初为NaNoRenO 2020活动制作的短篇视觉小说。

[摘自[url=https://azardragneel.itch.io/destination-prague]itch.io[/url]]
